title: UAT paper order
description: One order submitted by a persona during a session, before the paper broker has attempted it. Written to uat/runs/<run-id>/orders.jsonl. The rationale fields are mandatory: an order the persona cannot justify is not a trade this harness is interested in recording, and the justification is what makes the resulting dataset useful for anything beyond P&L.

decided_on.description: The last session date whose close informed this decision. The broker fills at the NEXT session's open, so this date is also the lookahead boundary the harness enforces.

quantity.description: Whole shares, as a string. Strings throughout: the ledger rejects binary floats in monetary and quantity fields and this file is a ledger input.

thesis.description: Why this position, now. Must reference something the persona actually read in the app this session.

invalidation.description: What would make this wrong. Required before the fill, never written after.

stop_level.description: Price at which the thesis is considered broken, as a decimal string.

regime.description: The macro read this order was sized under.

evidence.description: Figures from the app that supported the call, quoted with their source, e.g. 'RSI(14)=61.2 via GET /api/market/indicators?symbol=XLE'.
